channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Porter Medical Center nurses in Middlebury have approved a new three-year contract with annual wage increases. The deal includes better shift differentials, incentive pay, and bereavement leave. It covers one hundred forty-three nurses and was ratified by eighty percent of union voters.

The University of Vermont is expanding support for special needs students pursuing higher education. A new program received a one point two five million dollar federal grant. It will train special educators and provide scholarships for twenty-seven students over five years.
A woman was rescued after her car crashed into the Vermont shore of the Connecticut River Wednesday afternoon. Emergency responders quickly acted to get her out safely.
Ferrisburgh firefighters responded to a brush pile fire that got out of control. They are reminding residents about fire safety measures. The department urges caution during this fire season.
